card.name: Words before 'local' practice or guidelines
card.fires_on: Small words such as 'to' or 'local' right after 'according', 'per' or 'up', where the text goes on to defer to local practice, institutional guidelines or the physician's judgment.

modes.label: to after according/up
modes.description: The word 'to' following 'according' or 'up', leading into guidelines or physician discretion.
modes.example: Periodically evaluate serum triglycerides according<< to>> the clinical guidelines for hyperlipidemia

modes.label: local after per/according to
modes.description: The word 'local' itself, in phrases deferring to local practice or institutional guidelines.
modes.example: Administer prophylactic antiemetic medications per<< local>> institutional guidelines for prevention of chemotherapy-induced nausea

modes.label: own/one's reality
modes.description: Words in the phrase 'relate to one's own reality' in a course description.

card.writes: It pushes the model toward saying 'local' (or 'local' in Chinese) as the next word.
card.plain: It marks phrases like 'according to' that usually lead into 'local guidelines' or 'local practice'.
